issues.legal_issue: Whether the registrability of documents concerning rights to trees may be raised for the first time in a second appeal when deciding the issue depends on facts not investigated at trial.
material_facts: The documents concerned rights to cut trees and were relied on to establish title to those rights.
The issue of registration was first raised in the second appeals.
Whether the trees were standing timber or other trees had not been investigated, and the record did not permit that factual determination.
issues.conclusion: The registrability question was not a pure question of law and should not have been allowed to be raised for the first time in the second appeals. The appeals were dismissed. The Court expressed no opinion on res judicata because the registrability issue did not arise for decision.
issues.legal_principle: Under Sections 17 and 49 of the Registration Act, a document creating an interest of the specified value in immovable property requires registration, and an unregistered document is subject to the statutory evidentiary restriction. Section 2(6) includes things attached to the earth in immovable property but excludes standing timber. Whether the trees were standing timber was a question of fact; because that fact had not been investigated, registrability was not a pure question of law suitable to be raised for the first time in a second appeal. No earlier cases were relied on.

rule.if: second_appeal and document_concerns_rights_to_trees and registration_issue_first_raised_on_appeal and tree_nature_not_investigated

predicates.second_appeal: The proceeding is a second appeal from a lower court decision.
predicates.document_concerns_rights_to_trees: A document relied on in the case concerns rights relating to trees.
predicates.registration_issue_first_raised_on_appea: A party first raises whether the document required registration at the appeal stage.
predicates.tree_nature_not_investigated: The nature of the trees relevant to deciding the registration issue was not investigated in the lower court proceedings.
predicates.new_mixed_question_not_considered: A question requiring unresolved factual determination is not considered when raised for the first time at that appeal stage.

issues.definition: When a second appeal concerns a document relating to rights to trees and the registration issue is raised for the first time there, the issue is not considered if the relevant nature of the trees was not investigated.
